  • Constructor Details

    • PathExp

      protected PathExp(Object... operands)
      Creates a path node from the single operand: a CayennePath, or any other object whose String form is parsed as a path. A null operand results in an empty path. No operands result in a bare node with no path.

  • Method Details

    • getOperandCount

      public int getOperandCount()
      Description copied from class: Expression
      Returns a count of operands of this expression. In real life there are unary (count == 1), binary (count == 2) and ternary (count == 3) expressions.
      Overrides:
      getOperandCount in class Expression

    • setOperand

      public void setOperand(int index, Object value)
      Description copied from class: Expression
      Sets a value of operand at index, growing the operands array if needed. Operand indexing starts at 0. A Persistent is replaced with its ObjectId. A nested expression is asked first whether this node is a valid parent for it, see Expression.isValidParent(Expression).
      Overrides:
      setOperand in class Expression

    • getExpandedPath

      public CayennePath getExpandedPath()
      Returns the path with aliases expanded, so that each segment is a name of an attribute or a relationship. This is the form that Entity.resolvePath(CayennePath) expects.

    • getPathAliases

      public Map<String,String> getPathAliases()
      Description copied from class: Expression
      Returns a map of path aliases for this expression. It returns a non-empty map only if this is a path expression and the aliases are known at the expression creation time. Otherwise an empty map is returned.
      Overrides:
      getPathAliases in class Expression
